alt: Diwche at his desk, one eye behind a camera and a quill in the other hand, a clockwork owl on his shoulder.
Diwche standing with a finger to his temple, weighing whether a page is worth his morning.
Diwche in shirtsleeves and waistcoat, writing in an open ledger with a quill, an inkwell and a pot of pens on the desk beside him.
Diwche posting a wax-sealed parcel into a mailbox, letters waiting at his feet.
Diwche in a tinkered-together instrument vest, a colander on his head and dials on his chest, reading his own numbers.
Diwche resting his head on one hand over a sketch he has struck through in red, crumpled drafts and a forgotten mug around him.
